name: Chancellor's Committee Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Students Bursary
summary: Once-off bursary for Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander undergraduate students at the University of Sydney.
who: Undergraduate or undergraduate diploma student who is Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander
Must also meet the general advertised bursary criteria
catches: Advertised bursaries open in set rounds; the Semester 2 2026 round closed 13 September 2026, so watch for the next round
Meeting the criteria does not guarantee a bursary
